name: phew
description: Bug fixed. Phew. Open-source AI coding agent for VS Code: one-click fixes, review in the editor, checkpoints, chat history, worktree agents, and any model.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, Phew only answers questions. It does not change files, run commands, start MCP servers, or read project rules.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Phew needs files on disk to run commands and checks.

commands.title: Phew it! Fix Problem at Cursor
Phew it! Fix All Errors in File
Phew it! Fix Last Failed Terminal Command
Point Other Agents to Handoff Notes (AGENTS.md)

id.description: Stable identifier. The API key in the secret storage uses it.

name.description: Display name in the model switcher.

enumDescriptions: OpenAI Chat Completions format: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM, and more.
Native Anthropic Messages API.
Native Google Gemini API.
Language models that VS Code provides, for example GitHub Copilot.

baseUrl.description: API base URL, for example https://api.openai.com/v1.

model.description: Model name of the provider, or the VS Code language model ID.

auth.description: How the API key is sent. The default depends on the provider.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable with the API key. A key in the secret storage wins.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers. Do not put secrets here.

query.description: Extra URL query parameters, for example api-version.

extraBody.description: Extra JSON fields for the request body, for example reasoning_effort, thinking, or generationConfig.

maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens. Anthropic uses 8192 when empty.

price.description: Price in US dollars per million tokens.

contextWindow.description: Context window in tokens, for the context meter and automatic compaction.

phew.models.markdownDescription: Model profiles. Use **Phew: Add Model** and **Phew: Manage Models** instead of editing by hand. API keys are stored in the VS Code secret storage, not here. Only user settings can define models, so a workspace cannot redirect your API keys.

phew.activeModel.markdownDescription: The `id` of the model in `#phew.models#` that Phew uses. Use **Phew: Switch Model** or the model button in the chat.

phew.model.maxRetries.markdownDescription: Automatic retries after rate limits (HTTP 429), overloaded servers, server errors, and network errors. Phew waits as long as the provider asks. A missing quota or credit is never retried.

phew.agent.defaultMode.markdownDescription: Mode for new chats: `ask`, `plan`, `code`, `debug`, `review`, or the `id` of a custom mode.

phew.agent.maxSteps.markdownDescription: Maximum number of model calls in one task.

phew.chat.restoreLastChat.markdownDescription: Open the last chat of the workspace after a restart.

phew.chat.autoTitle.markdownDescription: Name each chat after its first answer, for example **Fix login redirect loop**. Phew asks the chat model for a few words once per chat. A name that you set yourself never changes.

phew.chat.historyLimit.markdownDescription: Number of saved chats per workspace. Older chats are deleted.

phew.chat.showThinking.markdownDescription: Show the reasoning of models that stream it, for example DeepSeek, Claude with extended thinking, or Gemini with thoughts.

enumDescriptions: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a new line.
Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) sends, Enter adds a new line.
phew.chat.sendWith.markdownDescription: The key that sends a message.

phew.context.autoCompact.markdownDescription: Summarize the older part of a long chat automatically when the context window is nearly full.

phew.context.compactAt.markdownDescription: Share of the context window that starts the automatic compaction.

phew.context.defaultWindow.markdownDescription: Context window in tokens for models without a `contextWindow` in their profile.

enumDescriptions: Notify when VS Code is in the background or the chat is not visible.
Always notify.
Never notify.
phew.notifications.onComplete.markdownDescription: Notify when a chat finishes or needs your input.

phew.notifications.minSeconds.markdownDescription: Notify about a finished task only when it took at least this many seconds. Quick answers do not need a notification. A request for your input always notifies.

enumDescriptions: No sound.
Only when the chat is hidden or VS Code is not focused.
Every time a task ends or needs your input.
phew.notifications.sound.markdownDescription: When to play a sound at the end of a task or when the agent needs your input.

enumDescriptions: A soft sigh of relief.
A short chime.

phew.assistant.name.description: The name of your assistant, for example Max. It is shown in the chat and in notifications.

phew.assistant.avatar.markdownDescription: A look of the Phew family (`look:cat`, `look:bot`, `look:ghost`, `look:sprout`, `look:nerd`, `look:night`, `look:angel`, `look:ninja`), one emoji, or up to two letters. Leave empty for the living Phew drop.

enumDescriptions: Short and to the point, like a senior pair programmer.
Explains why, and teaches while it works.
Minimal words, maximum code.
Cares about quality, security, and tests.
Uses your own description below.

phew.assistant.customPersona.markdownDescription: Your own description of the character. Used when **Persona** is `custom`.

phew.assistant.userName.description: How the assistant calls you. Leave empty to skip names.

phew.assistant.language.markdownDescription: The language of the answers: `match` answers in your language. Or a language name, for example `Russian` or `English`.

enumDescriptions: Your messages on the right in bubbles, answers on the left.
Blocks with an accent line.
Dense, without headers.
phew.appearance.style.markdownDescription: Layout of the chat. You can also change it with the **Aa** button in the chat.

phew.appearance.accentColor.markdownDescription: Accent color of the chat, for example `#22b8cf`. Leave empty to use the theme color.

phew.appearance.userBubbleColor.markdownDescription: Background of your messages. Leave empty to mix the accent color with the theme.

phew.chat.fontSize.markdownDescription: Font size of the chat in pixels. Leave empty to use the VS Code font size.

phew.appearance.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Font of the chat, for example `Inter, sans-serif`. Leave empty to use the VS Code font.

phew.appearance.lineHeight.markdownDescription: Line height of the chat text. Leave empty for 1.5.

phew.appearance.codeFontSize.markdownDescription: Font size of code blocks in pixels. Leave empty to use the editor font size.

enumDescriptions: Show the time when the pointer is over a message.
Always show the time.
Never show the time.
phew.appearance.timestamps.markdownDescription: When the chat shows the time of messages.

enumDescriptions: Show Restore, Edit, and Copy when the pointer is over a message.
Always show them.
phew.appearance.messageActions.markdownDescription: When the chat shows the message actions.

phew.appearance.avatars.markdownDescription: Show the avatar and the name of your assistant above each answer. Off by default for a calmer chat.

enumDescriptions: The mascot blinks, shows what the agent does with its eyes, follows the pointer on the welcome screen, and dozes off after a few idle minutes.
The mascot blinks and changes its face, but its eyes stay in place.
The mascot does not move. Only its face changes.
phew.appearance.mascot.markdownDescription: How much the Phew mascot moves. The mascot always stays still when your system asks for reduced motion.

enumDescriptions: Apply each change at once and review it in the editor with Keep and Undo buttons.
Show each change as hunks in the chat and apply only the hunks that you approve.
Apply changes without a review. Checkpoints still let you undo them.
phew.review.mode.markdownDescription: How you review the file changes of the agent.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every command.
Run commands from #phew.commands.autoApprove# without asking. Ask for all others.
Run every command that is not dangerous and not chained without asking.
phew.commands.approval.markdownDescription: When commands run without a confirmation. Dangerous commands such as `git push`, `terraform apply`, or `rm -rf` always ask.

phew.commands.autoApprove.markdownDescription: Command prefixes that run without a confirmation, for example `npm test` or `go test`. Dangerous and chained commands always ask.

enumDescriptions: Show the agent's commands live in a terminal of the chat, and open it with the first command. Ctrl+C stops a command; typing answers it.
Keep the terminal of the chat, but open it only when you click Show terminal.
No terminal; the chat shows the output.
phew.commands.terminal.markdownDescription: The terminal of the chat, which mirrors the agent's commands while they run. The chat always shows the output too.

phew.verify.command.markdownDescription: Command that checks the work, for example `npm test` or `npm run lint && npm test`. In Code mode, Phew runs it after changes and keeps fixing until it passes.

phew.verify.maxAttempts.markdownDescription: How many times Phew runs the check before it stops.

phew.budget.maxCostPerTask.markdownDescription: Stop a task when its cost reaches this amount in US dollars. `0` means no limit. Needs a `price` in the model profile.

phew.budget.maxTokensPerTask.markdownDescription: Stop a task when it uses this number of tokens. `0` means no limit.

enumDescriptions: Conventional Commits, for example `fix(auth): handle expired tokens`.
A plain imperative subject, for example `Handle expired tokens`.

phew.commit.maxSubjectLength.markdownDescription: Maximum length of the subject line.

phew.commit.includeBody.markdownDescription: Add a short body that explains what changed and why.

phew.commit.signOff.markdownDescription: Add `Signed-off-by: Name <email>` with your Git identity (Developer Certificate of Origin). Phew also adds `--signoff` to `git commit` commands of the agent.

enumDescriptions: Follow `commit.gpgsign` of your Git configuration.
Always sign commits with GPG or SSH (`--gpg-sign`).
Never sign commits (`--no-gpg-sign`).
phew.commit.gpgSign.markdownDescription: Signing of commits made with Phew and of `git commit` commands of the agent.

phew.commit.author.markdownDescription: Author for commits made with Phew, in the form `Name <email>`. Leave empty to use `user.name` and `user.email` of Git.

phew.commit.trailers.markdownDescription: Extra trailers for generated messages, for example `Refs: #123`. Phew never adds co-authors or other trailers by itself.

phew.commit.instructions.markdownDescription: Extra rules for commit messages, for example `Mention the Jira ticket from the branch name`.

phew.commit.model.markdownDescription: The `id` of the model for commit messages. Leave empty to use the active model.

phew.commit.assistedByTrailer.markdownDescription: Add an `Assisted-by: Phew` line to generated commit messages. Off by default: Phew never adds trailers unless you ask.

phew.worktrees.location.markdownDescription: Folder for agent worktrees. Leave empty to use a folder next to the repository.

phew.worktrees.branchPrefix.markdownDescription: Prefix of the branches of worktree agents.

phew.index.enabled.markdownDescription: Index the code so that the agent finds relevant code with `search_code`. The index stays on your computer.

phew.index.exclude.markdownDescription: Extra glob patterns that the index skips, for example `**/generated/**`.

phew.index.embeddings.markdownDescription: Optional semantic search with embeddings: `{ "profile": "<model id>", "model": "text-embedding-3-small" }`. Works with OpenAI-compatible and Gemini profiles. The code chunks are sent to that provider.

phew.autocomplete.enabled.markdownDescription: Show inline completions while you type. Each completion is a model request.

phew.autocomplete.model.markdownDescription: The `id` of a fast model for completions. Leave empty to use the active model.

phew.autocomplete.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Delay after typing before a completion request.

phew.nextEdit.model.markdownDescription: The `id` of the model for **Phew: Suggest Next Edit**. Leave empty to use the active model.

phew.memory.enabled.markdownDescription: Let the agent remember durable project facts in `.phew/memory.md` and read them in every chat.

phew.modes.markdownDescription: Custom modes. Example: `[{ "id": "docs", "name": "Docs", "instructions": "Write clear documentation.", "tools": ["read", "edit"] }]`. Projects can also add modes in `.phew/modes.json`.

phew.skills.enabled.markdownDescription: Use Agent Skills: folders with a `SKILL.md` file in `.phew/skills`, `.agents/skills`, `.claude/skills`, or `.opencode/skills` of the project or the home folder. The agent loads a skill when a task matches it.

phew.skills.paths.markdownDescription: Extra folders with skills. `~` means the home folder.

phew.handoff.enabled.markdownDescription: Keep a journal of each chat in `.phew/sessions/` and write handoff notes in `.phew/handoff/`, so that Phew or any other agent can continue the work. The journal never leaves your computer.

enumDescriptions: After a task that changed files, and when the chat is compacted.
After every task.
Only with /handoff.
phew.handoff.auto.description: When Phew writes a handoff note. Each note uses one short model request.

enumDescriptions: Notes stay on this computer: .phew/handoff/ is in .phew/.gitignore.
Notes can be committed, so teammates and their agents can continue the work. Journals always stay local.
phew.handoff.share.description: Whether handoff notes are kept out of Git.

enumDescriptions: Ask once per workspace.
Always keep the section up to date.
Never change these files.
phew.handoff.agentsFile.markdownDescription: Add a short section to `AGENTS.md` (and to `CLAUDE.md` and `GEMINI.md` when they exist) that points other agents to the latest handoff note. Phew changes only its own section.

phew.mcp.servers.markdownDescription: MCP servers. Local servers use `command`, remote servers use `url` and can sign in with OAuth. Example: `{ "github": { "url": "https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/" }, "fs": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "."] } }`. Values can use `${env:NAME}`, `${input:id}`, and `${workspaceFolder}`.

phew.mcp.readWorkspaceConfigs.markdownDescription: Also use the servers from `.vscode/mcp.json` and `.mcp.json` (Claude Code) of trusted workspaces.

phew.mcp.disabledServers.markdownDescription: MCP servers that Phew does not start. Use **Phew: Manage MCP Servers**.

phew.mcp.disabledTools.markdownDescription: MCP tools that the agent cannot use, by server. Use **Phew: Manage MCP Servers → Choose tools**.

phew.privacy.redactSecrets.markdownDescription: Remove values that look like keys, tokens, and passwords from tool output before it goes to the model.

phew.privacy.sensitiveNames.markdownDescription: Extra file name parts that Phew never reads, in addition to `.env`, keys, and credential files.

phew.terminal.offerFix.markdownDescription: Offer **Phew it!** when a command fails in the integrated terminal. Needs terminal shell integration.

phew.ui.celebrate.markdownDescription: Show a short **Phew! Done.** animation when a task changes files successfully.

phew.stats.minutesPerBug.markdownDescription: Minutes that one fixed bug saves, for the estimated time saved in the statistics.

scripts.lint: biome check src test scripts media
scripts.format: biome check --write src test scripts media
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.package: npm run check && node scripts/build.mjs --production && vsce package --out phew.vsix
